Gate 1 v0.6.0 — school kanji learning-card data

source here is for reproducible release builds and must be revisited.

KanjiVG stroke path extraction is a derivative of the r20250816 release.

Elementary grade allocation order and the official Joyo character list were
cross-checked against the CC0 kanji-data project by mimneko,
revision 0be3577f7939ec85d2b4e373a7a94262e7449e13:
https://github.com/mimneko/kanji-data
These school-year orderings and junior-high subdivisions are not official
semester scheduling. The middle-school 370/370/370 groupings and per-year
first/second-half split are explicitly estimated heuristics.
